objective_summary.value: The objective of SPICE is to better understand combustion processes by observing flames in microgravity aboard the ISS and in ground experiments. It aims to determine laminar smoke-point properties, flame lengths, and sooting propensity under various burner diameters and co-flow conditions.
objective_summary.quote: The objective of SPICE is to better understand the complex process of combustion by observing flames in a microgravity environment aboard the International Space Station (ISS) and analogous ground experiments.
